title: Mongo: scale-out remove (rs.remove)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove mongo <node>`: rs.remove()s a SECONDARY from nexus-rs. Refuses the PRIMARY (step it down first).

observe.what: removed mongo-3:27017 from nexus-rs (node still running; ready for re-add or deprovision)

whatProves: MongoAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync rs.remove()s a member with a primary-guard (refuses removing the current PRIMARY).
